The '''EU LCS 2018 Summer Split''' was the second and final split of the 2018 [[European League of Legends Championship Series]] season, organized by Riot Games and held from June 15 to September 9, 2018. The season featured ten teams competing in a Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo1}} Group Stage, followed by a Single Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}} Playoffs to determine the European champion and the region’s representative at the [[World Championship/2018|2018 World Championship]]. Matches were primarily played at the EU LCS Studio in Berlin, Germany, with the finals taking place at the Palacio Vistalegre in Madrid, Spain.

This split marked the final season under the '''EU LCS''' branding, as starting in 2019 the league was rebranded to the '''LEC (League of Legends European Championship)''' and transitioned to a franchised model, eliminating the promotion and relegation system.
